caption: The drawing features two main objects on a beige background. On the right side, there is a colored illustration of a metallic, rust-colored object with a rounded, flat, and broad end attached to two long, parallel handles that each end in a rounded knob. The metal surface shows variations in color, including dark brown, reddish, and hints of green, suggesting corrosion. The two handles are depicted as cylindrical and extend diagonally from the bottom left of the image toward the upper right, converging at the rounded end. On the left side of the drawing, there is a technical sketch of two cylindrical rods crossed at an angle, each passing through oval-shaped beads or segments marked with numbers and symbols (such as "1880" and "CMX") surrounded by triangular decorations. Lines and measurements are included in this sketch, indicating dimensions. The overall composition places the colored object prominently to the right, while the technical diagram is smaller and positioned to the upper left of the drawing.
